_comment: Widely shared public claims about NEAR's economics, as published (read on 2026-10-21). kind = quote (verbatim) or summary (our paraphrase of the source's figures). inputs holds the source's own published numbers, typed in by hand like the figures in config.json. pipeline/verify.py grades each claim against metrics.json; make verify fails if a verdict no longer follows from the data.

claims.text: NEAR captures a growing share of fees, feeding buybacks that permanently remove NEAR from circulation.
NearBlocks shows 2,015,496 NEAR in buybacks.multisignature.near while revenue.near.org lists 1,510,411 NEAR, and nothing published explains the difference.

claims.who: SVRN x The Tie, NEAR Protocol report
claims.text: Buybacks would match issuance (the report's "deflation threshold") at about $177M of daily Intents volume, with issuance of 32.2M NEAR a year worth about $39.3M.
Buybacks would offset issuance at about $1.13B of daily Intents volume, at a NEAR price of $5.90 and a net take of about 4.6 bps.
The chain issues about 90K new NEAR a day, against about $30M a year of fee capture.

claims.who: SVRN's CEO on Bankless, reported by Stocktwits
claims.text: Buybacks are still real, but issuance runs six times higher.

claims.who: Bitwise (Ryan Rasmussen), reported by Crypto Briefing
claims.text: Buybacks are not yet enough to offset new issuance.
Realised issuance is about 2.45% a year, and the treasury receives about 10.13% of supply growth.
